description: This file defines data models for OpenAPI components using Pydantic, including schemas for API documentation such as Info, Server, Reference, Schema, and various request/response models.

classes.name: Schema
classes.description: Represents a JSON Schema object with various validation and structural properties.

classes.name: Reference
classes.description: Represents a JSON Reference object with a '$ref' field.

classes.name: SchemaType
classes.description: Type alias for JSON Schema primitive types.

classes.name: Example
classes.description: TypedDict for API examples with optional fields.

classes.name: ParameterInType
classes.description: Enum for parameter location types in HTTP requests.

classes.name: Encoding
classes.description: Defines encoding options for media types.

classes.name: MediaType
classes.description: Represents media type objects with schema, examples, and encoding.

classes.name: ParameterBase
classes.description: Base class for parameters with common serialization and schema fields.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Parameter object with name and location.

classes.name: RequestBody
classes.description: Request body object with content and description.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Response object with description, headers, content, and links.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Operation object defining API endpoint behavior.

classes.name: PathItem
classes.description: Path item object with HTTP method operations.

classes.name: HTTPBase
classes.description: Base class for HTTP security schemes.

classes.name: SecurityScheme
classes.description: Union of all security scheme types.

classes.name: Components
classes.description: Components object holding schemas, responses, parameters, etc.

classes.name: BaseModelWithConfig
classes.description: Base class extending Pydantic's BaseModel with custom config.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Server object with URL, description, and variables.

classes.name: XML
classes.description: XML object for namespace and attribute info.
